## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **continuation supplement** to **Dàoxuān's** main *Dà Táng nèidiǎn lù* ([KR6s0088](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0088), T2149, 664 CE), produced by **Dàoxuān** 道宣 (596–667) himself in the brief period between the main catalog's completion (664) and his death (667). The supplement adds further bibliographic and translation-history materials that came to Dàoxuān's attention after the main catalog's completion. Preserved at T55 no. 2150.

**Abstract**

Authorship and date: composed by **Dàoxuān** 道宣 in the years immediately after the 664 main catalog's completion, before his death in 667. *notBefore* = **664**, *notAfter* = **667**. Catalog dynasty 唐.

The work is a **brief supplement** containing additional bibliographic data that Dàoxuān gathered after completing the main catalog — particularly material on Tang-period translation activity that postdated the main catalog's bibliographic cutoff. It functions as the **author's own addendum** rather than an independent work; its single-juan extent makes it a slim supplement to the 10-juan main catalog.

The work is consequently of less independent bibliographic significance than [KR6s0088](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0088) but is essential for the **complete reconstruction of Dàoxuān's bibliographic project**. Modern scholarly use of the *Dà Táng nèidiǎn lù* tradition treats the main catalog and the supplement as a single combined documentary unit.
